data.heading: Muscles
data.text: There are more than 600 muscles in the human body. Muscles attached to your bones help the body move.
Other muscles help to move things around the body, like blood through your blood vessels, and food through your food canal.
The heart is a muscle which pumps blood around the body.
The muscles attached to the bones give your body strength and help it to move.
It takes seventeen muscles to smile and forty-three to frown!
Muscles work by contracting and relaxing. Contracting makes the muscles shorter.
Relaxing makes them longer and thinner.
